{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales_df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Confirm the structure
print("Shape:", sales_df.shape)
print("Columns:", sales_df.columns.tolist())
print("Unique customer_segments:", sales_df['customer_segment'].unique())
print("Missing values in customer_segment:", sales_df['customer_segment'].isnull().sum())

# Inspect revenue column type and example values
print("Revenue dtype:", sales_df['revenue'].dtype)
print("Sample revenue values:", sales_df['revenue'].head(10).tolist())

# Check for refunded orders
print("Refunded orders count:", sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0])

# Check for invalid age values
print("Invalid age values (=-1):", sales_df[sales_df['customer_age'] == -1].shape[0])"}
